The gravitational potential is derived by following the equations described in (cite: 2002ApJ...578..787C)

analysis_steps.goal: Image the HCN and HCO+ cubes and make moment maps

method.value: CASA imaging with robust 0.5, 2-channel binning; moment maps with Karma

evidence.quote: The integrated intensity moment zero and intensity weighted velocity maps were made using Karma (cite: 1996ASPC..101...80G).

method.value: Fit multi-Gaussian expansion to HST F814W major-axis profile after subtracting AGN (PSF 0.2'') and masking starburst ring

evidence.quote: We model the stellar luminosity profile by calculating the least-square value with the luminosity distribution without the ring and the AGN.
The starburst ring region is determined to be in the range of radii from $-11''$ to $-7''$ and from $8''$ to $13''$ along the major axis.

assumptions.value: Axisymmetric galaxy; constant I-band M/L radially

evidence.quote: we are assuming that the radial difference of the M/L ratio is negligible
We model the stellar luminosity profile by calculating the least-square value with the luminosity distribution without the ring and the AGN.
Even the peak before subtraction gives a mass of less than $6.00\times10^{6}M_{\odot}$ for a M/L ratio 5.14

analysis_steps.goal: Compute circular velocity field and model PVD

method.value: MGE_circular_velocity at i=46 deg, then KinMS thin axisymmetric disk convolved with beam, PA 130 deg

evidence.quote: We convolve the model cloud distribution with our beamsize ($1''.60 \times 2''.20$) to express the beam-smearing, and assume the molecular gas disk to be an axisymmetric thin disk.
The inclination angle is set to be $46^{\circ}$
We assume that the streaming motion remaining in the PVD is negligible.

analysis_steps.goal: Chi-square grid fit of M_BH and M/L to PVD

method.value: Extract 106 points from observed PVD above 3 sigma ~8 mJy; grid M/L 4.80-5.35 (0.01), M_BH 0.5-2.5e8 (0.1e8); errors at Delta chi2<=9

evidence.quote: the finer grid of model parameters is set to be from M/L$=4.80$ to 5.35 in steps of 0.01 and $M_{\rm BH}=0.5 \times 10^{8} M_{\odot}$ to $2.5 \times 10^{8} M_{\odot}$ in steps of $0.1 \times 10^{8} M_{\odot}$

key_parameters.value: kinematic PA 130±5 deg; velocity error = channel width 3.284 km/s plus Gaussian fit error

evidence.quote: is defined to be a sum in quadrature of the channel width (3.284 km s$^{-1}$) and the error from Gaussian fitting

fitting.value: chi-square grid, 2 free parameters, 104 dof, polynomial fit to Delta chi2

evidence.quote: Note that the degree of freedom becomes 104, because we have two free parameters

validation.value: Repeated with HCO+, F190N profile, and inclination 51 deg

evidence.quote: We therefore repeat our method using the ${\rm HCO}^{+} (J=1-0)$ emission line.

findings_qualitative.value: Dust extinction in F814W is not serious for the mass measurement

evidence.quote: We therefore conclude that the dust extinction effect with the F814W filter is not too serious for the measurement of the SMBH mass.

claims.hypothesis: Dense gas kinematics with ALMA can measure the SMBH mass of NGC 1097
claims.experiment: PVD fit of HCN J=1-0 with MGE+KinMS model
claims.finding: SMBH mass measured, consistent with M-sigma

evidence.quote: The measured SMBH mass is in good agreement with the SMBH mass and bulge velocity dispersion relationship.

claims.hypothesis: Result is independent of molecular tracer

evidence.quote: The estimated parameters are consistent between the two emission lines.

why_this_data.value: HCN used because of highest SNR

evidence.quote: Our main result is obtained using the HCN line because it had the highest signal-to-noise ratio (SNR).

limitations_admitted.value: Inclination uncertainty and possible warp or asymmetry not modelled

evidence.quote: this galaxy could have a warped or a misaligned structure, which could be interesting to investigate but requires a calculation for an asymmetric potential field.

referee_caveats_inferred: Resolution (~112-154 pc) does not resolve the BH sphere of influence
Only a major-axis PVD and 106 points with 2 free parameters; the inclination uncertainty is not propagated
Quoted 3 sigma errors; gas treated as thin axisymmetric disk despite non-circular motions

data_public_as_stated.value: ALMA Cycle 0 project cited; HST archive data

evidence.quote: This paper makes use of the following ALMA data: ADS/JAO.ALMA#2011.0.00108.S.

reproducibility.score_reason: Public data and a clear chi-square grid, but KinMS and calibration settings are unspecified.
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: Public Cycle 0 data, a numeric answer (M_BH, M/L), and a mostly described recipe.
